issues.description: Inconsistent specification for `messageOnMilk`: The problem statement (Part 2) requires `messageOnMilk(double milkVolume)` and an output including the volume `(volume: [milkVolume]L)`, but the UML diagram defines `messageOnMilk(): String` (no parameter), and the solution implements `Milkable.messageOnMilk()` with no parameters and returns strings without any volume. This makes the required method signature and expected output unclear and can cause student solutions to fail against tests expecting one of the variants.
issues.suggestedFix: Make all artifacts consistent by choosing one design: (A) change UML, `Milkable`, implementations, and any callers/tests to `String messageOnMilk(double milkVolume)` and include the volume in the returned string, or (B) update the problem statement to require `String messageOnMilk()` with no parameters and specify the exact no-volume output format expected.
